name: David
summary: Israel's second king, a shepherd turned monarch remembered as Israel's chief psalmist; tradition credits him with more psalms in this collection than any other author, written from both suffering and worship.

name: The Sons of Korah
summary: A guild of Levite temple musicians descended from Korah, credited with a cluster of psalms used in Israel's corporate worship.

name: Moses
summary: Israel's exodus-era leader and lawgiver, credited with the one psalm in this collection attributed to him, a meditation on human frailty and God's eternity.

name: The Psalmist
summary: The unnamed voice behind several psalms that carry no author's name in their heading; used here to represent those anonymous compositions.
